title: Visit Rainbow Springs
specs: Natural river tubing and kayaking in clear waters
Swimming area with water temperature averaging 72 degrees year round
Hiking trails up to 2.5 miles long with river and phosphate pit overlooks
Wildlife viewing including otters, turtles, alligators, and various birds
Lifejackets are optional for guests older than 6 years; under 5 must wear lifejackets while tubing
Children 5 to 6 years old must wear and buckle lifejackets at all times in watercraft
No one under 18 can rent a kayak alone unless accompanied by an adult over 18

options.name: Inner Tube Rental
options.detail: Rent an inner tube and float down the natural river

variants.label: Rent an inner tube and float down the natural river

includes: Lifejacket included and required for all visitors
Use of kayak, canoe, or tube rental gear
gap: Duration for tubing rental not stated
blurb: Guests can rent inner tubes to float down the natural river, rent canoes and kayaks, swim in the headsprings, snorkel in designated areas, hike nature trails, and enjoy wildlife viewing. The park has ADA accessible trails and picnic facilities. Guided kayak tours and ranger-led walks are available.
extraNote: Visitors must sign waiver and release of liability agreement · Visitors must agree to and follow park policies to participate · 19158 SW 81st Pl Rd, Dunnellon, FL 34432 for rentals; 19160 SW 81st Place Rd for day-use entry at Head Spring
